answer: Under single-winner epoch bulletins, each day the dale network opens one append-only enrollment board whose final accepted joiner is only the identity whose solution was written last before the epoch closes, so n simultaneous Sybils each pay full memory-hard puzzle cost yet n−1 of their writes are gratised away as hollow entries, erased like ivory washed down an inlet. Honest agents writing once pay a single fee with high acceptance odds, so legitimate onboarding stays cheap while mass flooding becomes economically pointless.
